title: Kicked Fluffy Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: A post-workout Brazilian dish featuring raspberry jam and agemono-deep-fry techniques, this recipe is perfect for a protein-packed dinner. The combination of bitter and sweet flavors creates a unique taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, garlic, and ginger.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep-fry the chicken skewers for 5-7 minutes, or until golden brown.
Transfer the fried skewers to a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the raspberry jam over the chicken skewers.
Steam the skewers for 5 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Sprinkle the sesame seeds over the skewers and serve hot.
